requirement.requirement_text:
系统提供一个 Telegram 机器人，用户通过文本、语音或图片与机器人交互，由 AI 智能体生成或修改图片。
输入与鉴权：用户通过 Telegram 发送消息、语音留言或图片；系统依据用户的 Telegram ID 进行鉴权，仅通过鉴权的用户可使用该服务。
输入处理：
- 文本消息：直接交给 AI 智能体处理；
- 语音消息：先经语音转写能力转换为文本；
- 图片：从 Telegram 下载后上传至文件托管服务，并生成可公开访问的 URL。
处理过程：
1. AI 智能体分析用户输入，判断执行文生图（根据文字描述生成新图片）还是图生图（依据提示词修改已有图片）；
2. 智能体调用相应的图像生成能力执行生成任务；
3. 生成采用异步方式：提交任务后按任务标识轮询生成结果，直至结果返回。
输出：图片生成完成后，通过 Telegram 消息将图片发回给用户。

source_spans.text: This workflow creates a Telegram bot that uses AI to generate and transform images through Grok Imagine models, with support for text, voice, and image inputs.
Telegram Input Handling: Users interact with the bot by sending messages, voice notes, or images. The workflow authenticates users based on their Telegram ID.

Text messages → Directly sent to the AI agent
   Voice messages → Transcribed using OpenAI Whisper, then converted to text
   Images → Downloaded from Telegram, uploaded to an FTP server (BunnyCDN), and the public URL is generated

analyzes user input and determines whether to:
   Generate a new image from text description (text-to-image)
   Transform an existing image using a prompt (image-to-image)

Text-to-Image: Creates images from text prompts using "grok-imagine/text-to-image" model
   Image-to-Image: Modifies existing images using "grok-imagine/image-to-image" model
The workflow uses Wait nodes to handle asynchronous image generation, polling Kie.ai for results via task IDs.
Once images are generated, they're sent back to the user through Telegram messages.
